cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make Them Your Deputy
cards.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've shaken the raffle box like you did. Now be my deputy and draw the first ticket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I shook it because it's empty. We haven't sold any tickets.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the empty-box check. You can take charge of sales under me. Start with that table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're the volunteers. They need tickets to sell, and you've locked the book in your drawer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then your first job is fetching the book. Here's the key; bring it back to me and I'll issue everyone's tickets.
